visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with multiple close-up shots of Taiwanese delicacies arranged on a black dining table in a traditional-style restaurant. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to the outside of a red brick building on a clear, sunny day. A young man with short dark hair, dressed in a green t-shirt and khaki cargo pants, carries a white tote bag. He points enthusiastically at a white sign that says My灶 before turning to enter through a glass-paneled door. (3) Inside the restaurant, the camera focuses on Michelin Bib Gourmand stickers from consecutive years on a window. It then cuts to a glistening bowl of braised pork rice. The main character is seen sitting at a table, using a white ceramic spoon to eat the rice mixed with green chives. (4) A series of rapid shots highlights various dishes, including a clay pot containing thick pieces of braised pork, a large bowl of chicken-based rice, and stir-fried greens with mushrooms. A server wearing a black uniform is briefly visible in the background, walking between the round wooden tables. (5) The main character is shown in an extreme close-up, enjoying a large piece of succulent braised meat with a satisfied expression. The camera then shows a hand-written receipt on a clipboard, indicating the restaurant name My灶 and a list of prices. The man pours clear tea into a small white cup. (6) Finally, the man is seen back outside the restaurant building, smiling broadly and making a peace sign gesture with his hand. The white My灶 sign is visible behind him against the brick wall. The overall color tone is natural and vibrant, reflecting a positive dining experience.
